newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIAN PLAYER STABBED IN BAR-ROOM BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIAN PLAYER STABBED IN BAR-ROOM BRAWL.

text.p: Romanian soccer player Laurentiu Lica was stabbed in the back during a weekend bar brawl between rival gypsy clans wielding ceremonial swords, police said on Monday.
Lica, 22, who plays for Austrian second division DSV Leoben, was recovering from surgery after Saturday's clash in a Bucharest bar.
"Lica's left lung was pierced by a stab from the back but he is now out of danger," a doctor at a central Bucharest hospital said.
Lica, a midfielder who once played for Dinamo Bucharest, said he believed he was the victim of a case of mistaken identity.
"I don't know them (the attackers) and I'm convinced they took me for somebody else," Lica, looking pale and drawn, told Reuters from his hospital bed.
Police said a hunt had been launched for the attackers.
